note: Rules of `sox project check PATH` (code: core/project_check.py, one function per rule id). Globs are matched with fnmatch against the project-relative posix path; `*` also crosses `/`; a pattern without `/` also matches the file name; a trailing `/` means a folder prefix. `exclude` is applied to every rule; projects add more with the config key project_check.exclude and the read_only_dirs of .ai/guard.json.

rules.what: A text file still refers to the retired SocratexAI v1 pipeline, its files or its old tool paths.
rules.fix: Delete the reference or point it at the current mechanism (`$SOCRATEX_HOME/modules/tools/scripts/`, `sox`, `.socratex/config.json`).

rules.what: A file of the retired SocratexAI v1 setup is still in the project.
rules.fix: Move anything worth keeping into AGENTS.md or .socratex/config.json, then delete the file.

rules.what: .socratex/config.json is missing, so the project is not onboarded.
rules.fix: Run `sox project init PATH --write`, or create .socratex/config.json containing {"schema_version": 1}.

rules.what: The config resolved for the project has errors, or the project file tries to relax a safety rule (safety.allow).
rules.fix: Fix the key named in the message (`sox config show --project PATH` shows the result); safety.allow may only be set in the owner's local/ layers.

rules.what: .socratex/flow.json breaks the flow grammar or points to a missing stage, role, rule or tool.
rules.fix: Run `sox flow check --project PATH` and fix the listed steps.

rules.what: An entry file is longer than its limit: the project file should hold project facts only.
rules.fix: Move detail into docs referenced from INDEX.json; delete anything the core rules already say.

rules.what: CLAUDE.md does not import AGENTS.md, so Claude and Codex read different rules.
rules.fix: Put `@AGENTS.md` on the first line of CLAUDE.md and keep only Claude-specific notes below it.

rules.what: INDEX.json is not valid project-index/v1, or an entry points to a path that does not exist.
rules.fix: Set "schema": "project-index/v1" and remove or correct the listed paths (template: templates/project/INDEX.json).

rules.what: An entry file or doc repeats a core rule instead of pointing to it.
rules.fix: Delete the copy: core rules load from $SOCRATEX_HOME/defaults/RULES.md, and a copy drifts. Keep only what differs for this project.
patterns: Never read or edit secret files

rules.what: A project file has the name of a core script (modules/tools/scripts) or core agent (claude/agents): a fork that will drift.
rules.fix: Delete the fork and call the core one from $SOCRATEX_HOME, or give the project tool a different name if it is not a copy. Generic script names listed in `patterns` are exempt.

rules.what: The project's .claude/settings.json adds a PreToolUse guard hook next to the global one.
rules.fix: Remove the hook; put project-specific blocks into .ai/guard.json (blocked_commands, read_only_dirs, big_files).

rules.what: A routing, risk or guard override lives outside .ai/ and the project's SocratexAI/ folder under a non-standard name, so nothing reads it.
rules.fix: Move it to the standard place: the project's SocratexAI/ folder (risk rules via config key risk_rules), .ai/guard.json, or the config key routing.tier_overrides for model tiers.

rules.what: A project override file has a key the core does not read (keys starting with _ are allowed as notes).
rules.fix: Remove or rename the key; the allowed keys are listed in `sox project explain PRJ-GUARD-SCHEMA`.

rules.what: .ai/ROUTING.json is deprecated and no code reads it.
rules.fix: Move the tiers to .socratex/config.json: {"routing": {"tier_overrides": {"<agent>": "cheap|standard|high"}}}, then delete the file.
